title: Explicit five-term rational error envelope for a fixed coefficient-four family

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let R(n) be the sum of the monomials in guarantee.remainder.terms, each coefficient times n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent; an empty sum is zero. There exists N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-R(n) for every integer n>=N. All remainder coefficients are the exact declared constants. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total certificate-prefix language defined by the fixed evaluator in proof.md. At actual length N<2^20 output 0. Otherwise let b be the least positive integer with b^5>=N^3, let ell be the least prime strictly greater than b, put r=floor(N/ell)-1 and t=ceil(sqrt(r)). Read the first ell input bits as the coefficients below the leading term of a monic degree-ell polynomial P over F_2; output 0 unless X^(2^ell)=X mod P and gcd(P,X^2-X)=1. For a valid prefix read the next r*ell bits as x_1,...,x_r in K=F_2[X]/(P), in the polynomial basis with constant coefficient first; set y_i=x_i^(2^(r+2-i)-1) and output the absolute trace of the order-t elementary symmetric polynomial in y_1,...,y_r. Ignore the final N-(r+1)*ell bits. All prefix, payload and ignored bits count in N.
